# Embelish and Sendshards instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read `embelish/AGENTS.md` and the documentation for the script being edited: `docs/embelish/README.md` or `docs/sendshards/README.md`.

Preserve Embelish's native 7-Zip/password-console flow, shard format, modes, overwrite rules, results and staging cleanup. Do not add password capture or unattended credential handling. Read the existing limitations before claiming archive authenticity or sanitized logs.

Preserve Sendshards' separate plan/resumable-push modes, exact-byte/branch/remote validation, original time budget, deterministic pacing, owned-process cleanup, external plans/checkpoints and active Git/security controls. Do not run a real transfer as a development check, restart its budget, blindly retry an uncertain push or alter history.

Keep the executable scripts unchanged for documentation extraction. Preserve native external help, including all 15 Embelish helper help blocks, and synchronize Markdown/XML. Check tokens, encodings and help from another directory; distinguish historical evidence, current checks, baseline analyzer findings and unavailable target acceptance.
